{{Quote|Bury the millennial-old debate whether sleeper ships, jump-gates, or a hyperbeacon network supplied the primary means of star travel during Xim's era, or whether beam-tubes, particle dischargers, and pulse-cannons were the actual armaments.|Professor S. V. Skynx|<ref name="Xim Week I">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>}}
'''Beam tubes''' were early energy weapons, developed prior to the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The precursor to the modern [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], beam tubes were most often associated with the [[Xim's empire|empire]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].

==Characteristics==
Beam tubes were early energy weapons, and the precursors to [[blast-rifle]]s and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="EGWT" /> Requiring two hands to carry and use,<ref name="Warfare" /> beam tubes were powered by a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] coupled with a large [[Gas/Legends|gas]] reservoir that weighed over thirty [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Beam tubes fired an energy-particle beam that had a range of about fifty [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="NEGWT" />

Beam tubes had a slow rate of fire, and their generator backpacks only held enough ammunition for one hundred shots. During combat, [[Squad/Legends|squads]] of beam-tubers alternated their fire and carried larger [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] on [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorsleds]].<ref name="Warfare" /> One of the major manufacturers of beam tubes was [[Timms UniStar Armaments]], who built the first ones. They manufactured the [[Emperor-4 beam tube]].<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
{{Quote|The author of this introduction wishes to express his perpetual gratitude to another holo-legend, the audacious Han Solo, who assisted in locating Xim's fabled treasure. Much to Solo's regret, the treasure provided little in the way of pecuniary reward, but for Ximologists everywhere, its trove of kiirium ingots, mytag crystals, beamtubes, and antique automatons is priceless.|S.V. Skynx|<ref name="Xim Week I" />}}
Over twenty thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], beam tubes were the first energy weapons developed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The creation of the weapon was made possible following the invention of the portable power cell and the discovery of high-energy gases. The introduction of beam tubes changed the face of warfare, easily defeating the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of the day that had been designed to counter high-velocity projectile weapons.<ref name="EGWT" />

Beam tubes were used to great effect by [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Legion/Legends|legions]] during his military campaigns. During the [[Battle of Nuswatta]], where Xim's forces razed the [[High Fane of Xo]], the local theocracy was forcibly converted to the service of Xim's father, [[Xer VIII]], by threatening them with beam tubes. As Xim continued his conquests, [[Factory/Legends|factories]] on the worlds of [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]], [[Cadinth]], and [[Thanium]], produced massive beam tubes for use in ground assaults.<ref name="History">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> One of Xim's elite units, the [[Duinarbulon Star Lancers]], carried beam tubes into battle.<ref name="Warfare" />

As further developments led to the production of higher-yield power cells and miniaturized components, newer weapons became smaller and evolved into designs such as the blast-rifles used in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and eventually into the modern-day blaster.<ref name="EGWT" />

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="ERC-JA">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] series to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> a type of beam tube was still in use on the planet [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. [[Cerasi]], leader of [[The Young]], possessed a beam tube.<ref name="Defenders">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]''</ref> The weapons were also on [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]], although they fired missiles.<ref name="Truth">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the "[[Cradle of the Galaxy]]" exhibit, which was a collection of pre-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] artifacts, began a tour of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Ancient beam tubes from the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] were part of the exhibit, alongside [[war-robot]]s and parts of a [[jump gate accelerator]].<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|life/13314_4.html|New Xim Exhibit to Tour}}</ref>

The [[Survivors (Dellalt)|Survivors]], guardians of the [[Treasure Vaults of Xim the Despot]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] for thousands of generations, wielded beam tubes. They tirelessly protected the vaults.<ref name="EGWT" /> During his adventures on Dellalt, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] encountered the Survivors and was held prisoner by Survivors armed with beam tubes.<ref name="LL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>
